title: melittis caroliniana
intro: Melittis caroliniana, commonly known as Carolina balm, is a flowering plant species in the family Orobanchaceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing stress and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Carolina balm include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce anxiety, and soothe digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Melittis caroliniana include iridoid glycosides, such as melittoside and melittoside acetate, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
